name: Durotar Tiger Fur
summary: Across the Echo Isles off Durotar's southeastern coast, tigers supply fur for the Darkspear, whose refugee population keeps growing. The trolls use the pelts for blankets, tents, and armor.

sections.title: A Vital Resource for the Darkspear
sections.body: In Sen'jin Village, the Darkspear must make scarce supplies last. They let the local tigers thrive until their growing needs call for a cull. Trolls cure the thick hides into goods their settlement needs, including protective armor and warm blankets for changing seasonal weather.

sections.title: Hunting the Echo Isles
sections.body: The Echo Isles lie south of Durotar, across open water. The Darkspear once called the archipelago home, until the witch doctor Zalazane drove them out. Hunters face dangers from Zalazane's thralls and from tigers waiting among the thick foliage. Experienced hunters such as Vel'rin Fang speak of spending entire days motionless in the jungle brush to secure a single clean kill.

faq.q: Where are Durotar tiger furs obtained?
faq.answer: Hunters collect Durotar tiger fur from tigers across the Echo Isles, off Durotar's southeastern coast.

faq.q: Why do the trolls of Sen'jin Village need these furs?
faq.answer: Vel'rin Fang gathers the fur for the growing Darkspear settlement, where the trolls use it to make blankets, tents, and protective leather armor against seasonal weather.

faq.q: Why don't the trolls overhunt the tigers?
faq.answer: The Darkspear let the tiger population thrive and cull only when growing community needs strain supplies of shelter and clothing.

angles.text: For the Darkspear, tiger hides mean survival in Sen'jin Village and recall the painful loss of their homeland on the Echo Isles.
As a Hunter, stalking the Echo Isles tigers mirrors classic troll hunting rites, demanding patience and camouflage to ambush the stealthy island predators.
